key_insight: GyroFlow skips expensive transient simulation by learning the distribution of statistically steady turbulent states directly from noise, conditioned on operating parameters.
engineering_relevance: This offers a faster way to generate high-fidelity gyrokinetic turbulence snapshots for plasma modeling, surrogate evaluation, and warm-starting solvers.
method: Latent generative model for 5D gyrokinetic turbulence
Conditional generation from noise using dimensionless operating parameters
Distribution-focused evaluation with FGyD in pretrained latent space
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that GyroFlow outperforms autoregressive, reduced-order, and other generative baselines, and that FGyD correlates with downstream flux accuracy and solver convergence.
watch_item: The approach depends on an ergodicity assumption and pretrained latent representations, so performance may be sensitive to regime shifts or latent-space mismatch.
paper_title: A Shortcut to Statistically Steady-State Turbulence with Flow Matching
